verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so auto-growing storage billed by usage is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only mentions SSD-backed disks with daily snapshots for ClickHouse. Nothing documents disks growing automatically with usage or billing by bytes written rather than provisioned capacity.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know attached disk/storage auto-grows with usage and I'm billed only for bytes actually written rather than pre-provisioned capacity
